_comment: Mieza GTO MCP integration for strategic reasoning under competition and uncertainty
_source: https://mieza.ai/gto/mcp -- config from their MCP integration page
_usage: Add to Claude Code settings.json mcpServers, or to OpenClaw MCP config
_setup_steps: 5. Add the mcpServers block to your Claude Code settings or OpenClaw config

_capabilities.description: Game-theoretically optimal strategy computation via MCP
_capabilities.input: Game matrices, player strategies, payoff structures, uncertainties
_capabilities.output: Nash equilibrium strategies, mixed strategy probabilities, expected payoffs
use_cases: Buyer response modeling (how will prospects react to outreach posture?)
Competitor response (how will Harness react to category claims?)
Pricing strategy (premium vs wedge positioning under competition)
Market signaling (what does publishing our thesis reveal to competitors?)

_integration_with_globalmoo.pattern: Mieza computes scenario parameters -> globalMOO optimizes within those parameters
_integration_with_globalmoo.example: Mieza says 'aggressive outreach raises negative-response probability by 40%' -> globalMOO optimizes outreach mix with that constraint
